title: A lovely treat!
text: 90 minutes of restful massage in a relaxing environment (hints of old Roman design present in parts of the building). Jaime and partner were very pleasant (Jaime speaks English to a reasonable level).
author: Brian_H

title: It's like new!
text:
I loved! Super recommended! I requested it because I had walked so much and in so much heat. I had a leg massage and reflexology. 
It's like new! 
The room has a very beautiful atmosphere and energy. 
In particular, Jaime gives you peace just by seeing him.
author: Pellegaby

title: Perfect treat in Seville
text:
The best massages I’ve ever had.
A cozy place in the middle of Santa Cruz neighborhood.

Jamine was friendly warm yet calm & made me at ease immediately.
He listened to me very carefully while explaining my expectations to him.

Lucky enough to book 2,5h (combining 2 cessions, Infinito + Reiki) to have my body fully relaxed, literally from head to toe.
Gentle but very accurate without hurting muscles. 

His Reiki talent is something.
It really felt that I got rid of some accumulated negative energy, too.

I suggest you to get more than 60m if you feel exhausted from traveling or your everyday
author: Yasuyuki I

title: Pleasant and beneficial massage
text: Thank you for the warm Welcoming and especially the very relaxing massage. Mood is nice and quiet. The gentle but applied massage provides instant well-being. We'll be back soon. Gracias
author: DanielPfister

title: A luxurious massage
text: I loved the experience! First the place is very cozy and nice, in the heart of Santa Cruz neighborhood. Second Jaime is a Charm, at your Service for whatever you need. And Third party the massage was amazing, it left me very relaxed and without any pain, floating in a cloud. I recommend it without any doubt!
author: tiphainerichard

title: A healing experience
text:
A very “healing” experience. Jaime has been treating me for more than 4 years, with different treatments, for pregnancy, muscle pain and menopause. Their knowledge and professionalism in various techniques make you recover physically and mentally. Excellent service and easy access.
I'm delighted. 
One hundred percent recommended!
Thank you Jaime for your wisdom and sharing it with others.
author: KeilaC422
